name: OpenCode Go quotas
author: ziouf
description: Enriches the built-in Agents panel with extra LLM quota tabs: OpenCode Go rolling 5-hour / weekly / monthly windows (official usage API), OpenRouter balance and caps, and OpenAI Platform monthly limits. No widget, no UI of its own — the stock Agents panel picks the new tabs up automatically.

install.notes: `omarchy plugin add https://github.com/ziouf/omarchy-opencode-go-quotas.git --enable`, then make sure the service is listed in shell.json: { "plugins": [ { "id": "ziouf.opencode-go-quotas" } ] }. Tabs appear in your existing Agents panel as soon as provider credentials are found — nothing else to configure, and the panel itself is never modified or duplicated.

uninstall.notes: Removing the service stops the refreshes and unloads its tabs from the Agents panel on the next rescan. The commands above are documentation; run them manually for a spotless cleanup.
